question: What is the lowest physical bit rate at which an invertible signed-Hadamard transform, one shared log-gain byte per block, and bit-packed scalar normalized coordinates preserve the live full-MLP Muon feedback direction?

causal_parent.reason: Orthogonal mixing improved recovery monotonically but did not repair the Cartesian product-cell distortion. The frozen successor changes the cell by sharing one gain across a full transform block and measuring the true rate frontier.

theory.transform: u = H_B S_B e, g = sqrt(||u||^2/B), y = u/(g+epsilon), and e_hat = S_B H_B^T(g_hat Q_b(y))
theory.direction_support: H_B S_B is bijective and orthogonal before quantization; unlike a fixed low-dimensional weight generator it deletes no ambient direction.
theory.cell_change: A single gain code couples the radius of all B coordinates, while scalar codes describe the normalized direction in the mixed gauge. This is a block transform lattice rather than another independent pair product.
theory.persistent_metadata: Per matrix: 256 FP32 log-gain levels plus 2^b FP32 coordinate levels; no dense basis, dense master weight, dense momentum, or ambient residual.

aggregation.full_feedback_recovery: feedback-target-energy weighted across all 24 matrices, separately by (B,b) and probe step, plus minimum matrix recovery
aggregation.occupancy_entropy: minimum over all matrices and both probe steps for each (B,b)
aggregation.parseval: maximum matrix relative energy error over both probe steps

selection_rule.winner: candidate passing every validity and candidate gate at both steps with minimum physical rate b + 8/B bits per weight
selection_rule.ties: lower transform work wins; if still tied, larger block wins for lower gain overhead
selection_rule.production_authorization: a probe winner authorizes only a bit-packed persistent implementation, focused correctness/resume tests, exact-config MFU gate, and a new nine-update live direction gate

decision_policy.winner_exists: Implement only the selected rate. Do not launch 238-step conservation, an LM endpoint, a longer horizon, or a larger model until the live production codec passes direction, resume, and MFU gates.
decision_policy.no_winner: Close this scalar-coordinate transform-lattice family. Derive a higher-shaping-gain vector lattice or trellis at a comparable physical rate; do not sweep learning rate, model size, or horizon.

execution_policy.preflight: foreground exact-config real-training preflight; all eight diagnostic candidates are included in measured optimizer time
execution_policy.scientific_run: foreground-polled because nine updates are expected under five minutes; attach a persistent @Codex watchdog immediately only if observed runtime exceeds five minutes
execution_policy.callbacks: none expected for a sub-five-minute diagnostic
